snippet.title: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX: Credits Screen
snippet.description:
Full Title: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX: 1st Place @ Bowser's Castle & Credits Screen

Getting 1st place in the 4th round of the Bowser Cup in a single player race and the credits screen in the Mario Kart Arcade GP DX game (American version 1.04).

Note: At time of recording, there were 4 cabinets linked. However, you can't use multiplayer to get the Credits Screen.

Competitors in this race: Mario (P1), PAC-MAN (CPU), Bowser (CPU), Luigi (CPU), Rosalina (CPU), Peach (CPU)

Player Settings: 1 Player & 5 CPU
Track: Bowser's Castle (Bowser Cup)
Recording Date: September 30, 2015
Recording Location: Sherman Oaks Castle Park (Sherman Oaks, CA)

#mariokartarcadegpdx #endingscreen #staffcredits
